summary: street or small static prop: closed pieces that touch or push into each other, chamfered caps, a base that meets the ground; no gaps, no floating parts.

body.summary: the main volume and its sides

top.summary: cap, top and what sits on it

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.
This starter is generic: rename every item to the real part ('bin body', 'lid', 'wheel pair') and split the body into the pieces the design has.

items.name: Main body
items.construction: the main volume as closed pieces: chamfered box, 8-sided cylinder (mesh.lathe) or a lofted shape

items.name: Base or feet
items.construction: plinth, footing or feet whose bottom is flat on the ground (z = 0)

items.name: Cap or top
items.construction: cap with a lip or a chamfer that sits on or pushes into the body

items.name: Secondary parts
items.construction: the parts the design needs (door, lid, handle, slot, post, brace) as closed pieces touching the body
items.notes: split into one item per real part

items.name: Rims and lips
items.construction: rims, lips and chamfer bands where parts meet

items.name: Fixings
items.construction: bolts, hinges and brackets as small closed pieces touching the body

items.name: Inside faces of openings
items.construction: inside of mouths, slots and doors closed: nothing see-through

items.name: Labels and signs
items.construction: sign plates standing off the surface (a thin card or a box on the body)

items.name: Light source
items.construction: lens or bulb housing (with a 2dfx light)

items.name: Stickers, scuffs and stains
items.construction: in the texture on own faces, soft

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/prop.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
